title: Amazing guide and new friend!
text: My two friends and I had a wonderful day with Monia who was knowledgeable and personable! It was great making a friend and learning so much on our first day in la Costa Brava. We enjoyed a wine tasting and town visits and even did a little shopping- Monia was happy to personalize everything based on what we wanted to do. She gave us lots of recommendations for dining, beaches, and nightlife and hooked us up with a driver contact which helped us with our return to Barcelona later in the week. title: Best day EVER!
text: Amazing! Pretty much sums up our day. We had such a personalized one in a lifetime experience. Can NOT thank the wonderful, Monia for such a magical day. Monia is a local and she took us to all the family wineries and restaurants. All of which, we were treated like family and had nothing but VIP service. Highly recommend this experience to anyone and especially Monia!!! Monia, thank you for making us feel so special. We loved it and love you. Can't wait for next time !
author: Michael_T
